question: Which facilities have the highest 30-day readmission rate?
How have total charges changed by month?
Which specialties have the most complications?
What is the 30-day readmission rate by facility?
sql:
SELECT facility_name, ROUND(AVG(readmit_pct), 1) AS readmission_rate_pct, COUNT(*) AS encounters
FROM `<catalog>`.`<schema>`.gold_encounters
GROUP BY facility_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
ORDER BY readmission_rate_pct DESC

content:
This Genie space answers questions about synthetic hospital encounters. There is no PHI.
- Each row of gold_encounters is one encounter.
- readmit_pct, mortality_pct, and complication_pct are 0 or 100 per encounter; average them to get a rate.
- Express all rates as a percentage from 0 to 100, rounded to one decimal; show currency as whole dollars.
- When ranking providers or facilities by a rate, only include those with at least 200 encounters unless the user asks otherwise.
